title: When Vision Overrides Language: Evaluating and Mitigating Counterfactual Failures in VLAs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on counterfactual language instructions using the LIBERO-CF benchmark and conducting modality ablation (vision-only vs. language-only inputs) to measure over-reliance on visual cues instead of language intent.

Measuring the frequency at which models default to executing well-learned training tasks associated with specific visual scenes rather than faithfully following novel or alternative language instructions.
